items.title: Police crime data changes risk distorting London high street insurance pricing
items.summary: A new Seenity study suggests shifts in London high street risk scores may reflect police recording methods rather than true crime changes.

items.title: Fund managers scale back AI expectations and technology weightings
items.summary: Bank of America's Global Fund Manager Survey shows investors cutting tech allocations following economic soft-landing forecasts.

items.title: London Pensions Fund Authority reports £1.36bn surplus in annual figures
items.summary: The London Pensions Fund Authority has published its annual report for 2025-26, showing a funding level of 120%.

items.title: Lancashire receives Lloyd’s approval to merge Syndicates 3010 and 2010
items.summary: Lancashire Insurance Group has secured regulatory approval from Lloyd's of London to combine its Syndicates 3010 and 2010, with Syndicate 2010 stopping new business at year-end.

items.title: FCA sets out upcoming regulatory priorities for investment management
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has published the eleventh edition of its Regulatory Initiatives Grid detailing its focus for the next two years.

items.title: Rothesay completes £369m acquisition of Clifford Chance headquarters
items.summary: Pension insurer Rothesay has purchased the newly developed 2 Aldermanbury Square office building in London for £369m from Great Portland Estates.
